name: Click Gap Counter
description: Groups your clicks by how fast you click and shows the time between your last two clicks.

enabled.name: Show Click Gap Counter
enabled.description: Toggle the counter on or off.

show-readout.name: Show MS and Hz
show-readout.description: Show the time since your last click and the same thing as a rate.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: Opacity of the counter text (0 = invisible, 255 = solid).
